6.note: the 160 mm strip outside the eave is the gutter, not overhang: the exact Bramac rafter lengths (6.06 m at 42°, 7.7 m at 43°) end at the wall line. Built as 6 parts + 30 gable dormers: gross face areas equal the Bramac faces (existing roof 161.93 m² both), lines within 2.4% (valleys 0.1%). Area is 4.7% under Bramac because Bramac deducts less under each dormer (3.46 m² against the geometric 4.57 m²) and counts roof under the existing roof's overhang, which the core hides (cross gables, 12° shed).

4.note: A = tiles (priced), B = standing-seam metal (not priced). The metal decks are wide shed dormers cut into the tiled roof; their eave height is set so they meet the roof at the drawn depth (3.84 m in object A, 3.025 m in object B). Object A: tiles 110.4 m² against 113 (-2.3%). Object B: two wings (the oblique one as its own part), 11 decks; tiles 488 m² against 455 (+7.3%) while the ridge (75.8 m) matches the ridge tiles (75.7-77.1 m): the outline is right, what the offer leaves out of the 45° roof is open.
